# beowulf-fitt-04 — Fitt IV · An Answer on the Shore (lines 258–319)

62 lines, Klaeber printed pages 10, 11, 12.

## The lines

```
 258  Him se yldesta andswarode,
 259  werodes wīsa, wordhord onlēac:
 260  ‘Wē synt gumcynnes Gēata lēode
 261  ond Higelāces heorðgenēatas.
 262  Wæs mīn fæder folcum gecȳþed,
 263  æþele ordfruma, Ecgþēow hāten;
 264  gebād wintra worn, ǣr hē on weg hwurfe,
 265  gamol of geardum; hine gearwe geman
 266  witena wēlhwylc wīde geond eorþan.
 267  Wē þurh holdne hige hlāford þīnne,
 268  sunu Healfdenes sēcean cwōmon,
 269  lēodgebyrgean; wes þū ūs lārena gōd!
 270  Habbað wē tō þǣm mǣran micel ǣrende
 271  Deniga freân; ne sceal þǣr dyrne sum
 272  wesan, þæs ic wēne. Þū wāst, gif hit is
 273  swā wē sōþlīce secgan hȳrdon,
 274  þæt mid Scyldingum sceaðona ic nāt hwylc,
 275  dēogol dǣdhata deorcum nihtum
 276  ēaweð þurh egsan uncūðne nīð,
 277  hȳnðu ond hrāfyl. Ic þæs Hrōðgār mæg
 278  þurh rūmne sefan rǣd gelǣran,
 279  hū hē frōd ond gōd fēond oferswȳðeþ —
 280  gyf him edwenden ǣfre scolde
 281  bealuwa bisigu bōt eft cuman —,
 282  ond þā cearwylmas cōlran wurðaþ;
 283  oððe ā syþðan earfoðþrāge,
 284  þrēanȳd þolað, þenden þǣr wunað
 285  on hēahstede hūsa sēlest.’
 286  Weard maþelode, ðǣr on wicge sæt,
 287  ombeht unforht: ‘Ǣghwæþres sceal
 288  scearp scyldwiga gescād witan,
 289  worda ond worca, sē þe wēl þenceð.
 290  Ic þæt gehȳre, þæt þis is hold weorod
 291  frēan Scyldinga. Gewītaþ forð beran
 292  wǣpen ond gewǣdu, ic ēow wīsige;
 293  swylce ic maguþegnas mīne hāte
 294  wið fēonda gehwone flotan ēowerne,
 295  nīwtyrwydne nacan on sande
 296  ārum healdan, oþ ðæt eft byreð
 297  ofer lagustrēamas lēofne mannan
 298  wudu wundenhals tō Wedermearce,
 299  gōdfremmendra swylcum gifeþe bið,
 300  þæt þone hilderǣs hāl gedīgeð.’
 301  Gewiton him þā fēran, — flota stille bād,
 302  seomode on sāle sīdfæþmed scip,
 303  on ancre fæst. Eoforlīc scionon
 304  ofer hlēorber[g]an gehroden golde,
 305  fāh ond fȳrheard, — ferhwearde hēold
 306  gūþmōdgum men. Guman ōnetton,
 307  sigon ætsomne, oþ þæt hȳ [s]æl timbred
 308  geatolīc ond goldfāh ongyton mihton;
 309  þæt wæs foremǣrost foldbūendum
 310  receda under roderum, on þǣm se rīca bād;
 311  līxta se lēoma ofer landa fela.
 312  Him þā hildedēor [h]of mōdigra
 313  torht getǣhte, þæt hīe him tō mihton
 314  gegnum gangan; gūðbeorna sum
 315  wicg gewende, word æfter cwæð:
 316  ‘Mǣl is mē tō fēran; Fæder alwalda
 317  mid ārstafum ēowic gehealde
 318  sīða gesunde! Ic tō sǣ wille,
 319  wið wrāð werod wearde healdan.’
```
